notes: Starter-question tables and the goals section were empty in the exported ONB1 spec v1.1. Follow-up prompts, the restaurant pain question, GEN_LOCATIONS, the slot budget, the industry map, and the worked example are encoded as written.
Questions marked reconstructed or spec-partial use the slot map, rule triggers, and the worked example. Vincent should confirm those prompts before they are treated as final copy.
Child follow-up rules use the parent id plus b (for example RST-R3b) because the spec names the branch but not a separate rule id.
Goal ids G1-G8 are assigned from the worked example (G2 locations and revenue, G3 roles, G5 RST_INBOUND, G6 pain) plus the remaining interview jobs (business type, tools, 90-day outcome, contact).
